title: Complete quadratic truncation
statement: For a Boolean vector $w \\colon \\mathrm{Fin}(n) \\to \\{\\mathrm{false},\\mathrm{true}\\}$ and a natural number $k$, define its truncation through coordinate $k$ to have coordinate $i$ equal to the encoded value of $w_i$ when $i<k$, and equal to $0$ otherwise.
caveat: The encoding of Boolean values into $\\mathbb{F}_2$ is not defined in the supplied payload.
